brief: An island-town cottage lot: Steamboat Hotel, a 19th-century Lake Erie house; see the photo for its massing, porch and trim. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: the Lake Erie shore towns that stand in for Victory Bay's island streets (Vermilion, Sandusky, Put-in-Bay) were built 1840-1920, and Commons has almost no newer cottages there. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the old Steamboat Hotel (Vermilion, 1840s-80s), now a house: a long two-storey white clapboard building, many bays with black shutters, a gabled wing, a full screened porch with arched openings; a broad lawn and a clipped hedge

why.note: Vermilion OH: Lake Erie ship captains' houses of the 1840s-80s (the 'village of lake captains')
